title: This Crab's Pinch Rivals a Tiger's Bite (3,300 Newtons)

scenes.text: This crab can pinch as hard as a tiger bites.
It's the coconut crab, and it lives on tropical islands.
Scientists measured one crab under five pounds at 1,765 newtons. A human bite is about 900.
For the biggest crabs, they estimate up to 3,300 newtons. That matches a tiger's bite.
It uses that grip to crack coconuts and lift about 30 kilograms.
A crab with the pinch of a tiger.

This crab can pinch as hard as a tiger bites.
A study in PLOS One measured coconut crabs at up to 1,765 newtons and estimated the biggest could reach about 3,300, close to a tiger's bite. A human bite is about 900.
